title: The about page loses its third-party owner and its invented history, the team page loses its invented hierarchy
summary: Two pages still describe an organisation that does not exist. /company/ still names a third-party company as its owner, still counts ten years and three manufacturing hubs, and still walks a 2013-2026 milestone timeline. /our-team/ still publishes six invented job titles with bios - Managing Director through Project Engineer - and a five-department structure, which together imply a staff the company does not have while it is still being set up. This round removes the third-party entity name, the year count, the hub count and the timeline from /company/, and replaces the six role cards plus the department grid on /our-team/ with the single application and quotation contact block agreed in the work order. The page-level copy sweep, the product pages and the shared-layer response promise wording stay where they are - they belong to the later rounds.
